Mission Local reported that the State Bar sent District Attorney Brooke Jenkins to an ethics diversionary program over her accessing, downloading and emailing a confidential rap sheet for a case she wasn’t involved in. The story said the Bar acted after a two-and-a-half-year process and focused on that incident, while dismissing the other ethics complaints. The column argued that Jenkins’s conduct appeared to violate the law.
